_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_add_mana_on_tap.py. t_crypt_ghast is Crypt Ghast's second line alone; t_turn_ghast gates it on is_your_turn so the condition is shown to be asked; t_vernal_bloom is the any-player spelling ('whenever a Forest is tapped for mana, its controller adds'); t_swamp_maker makes every land a Swamp, Urborg's half, so the static is shown to read current subtypes; t_black_four_drop costs {B}{B}{B}{B}, castable off two Swamps only with the extra mana. t_wild_growth is the Aura spelling ('whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional {G}') -- tapped_permanent {'attached': true}, naming the one land it is attached to rather than a class of land. t_utopia_sprawl adds the chosen-colour rider on top -- add_mana {'chosen_color_of': 'self'}, the same spelling the add_mana op uses, read off the Aura at the mana choke point.
